hab: A ranch the size of a county
bio: A foal with a small blue polo patch on its chest. It stands very straight for its age.
A pony with a navy mane that falls just so and a chest patch everyone copies. It plays polo and wins quietly.
A horse so well dressed in its own coat that it sells the dream of being it. The shirt is the least of it.
note: Born in the Bronx, raised in a catalogue.
Sells a life, with a horse in it.
